title: Decision-making components and times revealed by the single-trial electroencephalogram
primary_outputs: Five-event inference and the contrast effects on inter-event latencies, plus original ERP/decision accuracy relationships.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.assessment: 26 cleaned512Hz MNE epoch FIF files with source-written event_name/rt/condition/side/stimulus/response metadata; preprocessing and photodiode corrections are upstream fixed inputs.

input_routes.version: Each observed file version 1; example SHA256 edd10eab6ecbae73d26a19c17f9e8d0838d77e99c7756da7d53bc1f616531535.
input_routes.license: Public read access; node_license is null. An explicit data redistribution license was not observed.

lineage_and_loader_evidence.source_inspection_level: Saved metadata, author documentation and selected source inspection; this audit did not newly read payloads.

data_contract.neural: 26 files 0_epo.fif through 25_epo.fif, each about 271 MB; publisher and official loader identify cleaned MNE EEG epochs at 512 Hz.
data_contract.labels: Source preprocessing writes epoch metadata event_name, rt, condition, side, stimulus and response, from stimulus/condition/side/response triggers; notebook reads those fields directly for contrast, speed/accuracy and correct-response analyses.
data_contract.time_alignment: Photodiode correction is in the preprocessing source; epochs retain sample rate and events. The initial contract starts after those corrections.
data_contract.split: Freeze participant groups and complete trials for extensions; trial PCA/scaling and HMP model estimation must be training-only if claiming held-out prediction. Original full-data event discovery is a descriptive reproduction.
data_contract.controls: Behavior-only reaction time, response/motor preparation, contrast intensity, and alternative event widths/numbers; test that HMP interval interpretations survive participant-held-out estimation.
data_contract.biological_unit: Participant, not the number of fitted EEG samples or event-probability points.

versions_and_loader_contract.scope_description: Refit hidden multivariate pattern events on released participant EEG epochs, then compare sensory/decision interval laws and ERP evidence. Scope starts from cleaned epochs and does not recreate manual acquisition/preprocessing decisions.

input_assets.checksum_interpretation: Explicit sha256 fields retained; checksum/digest/ETag names are not silently reinterpreted. None means unrecorded, not verified.

official_code.lineage_limit: Author/source code meaning is preserved. A loader, demo, figure script and complete-paper implementation are not interchangeable.

recorded_central_outputs: Five-event inference and the contrast effects on inter-event latencies, plus original ERP/decision accuracy relationships.
observable_endpoints.assessment: Five-event EEG inference and contrast-related inter-event latency laws are identified; no numerical central-effect contract or validated event-number selection is present.
observable_endpoints.missing_common_contract: Exact score/estimand, inclusion, figure-specific reference outputs and numerical tolerances must be frozen; source text alone does not establish reproduction.

comparability: 100Hz laptop processing differs from the author512Hz recipe. Preserve correct-response selection and distinguish held-out likelihood from explanatory psychophysical-law fits.
Paper+data versus +official-code arms still need one identical empirical task, matched noncode resources/budgets, separate source exposure, and preserved reproduction→improvement stages.
